name: TG File Sharing Bot
description: Telegram bot that stores posts in a private channel and shares them with special links.

CHANNEL_ID.description: Database channel id, for example -1001234567890. A positive t.me/c id is accepted.

OWNER_ID.description: Numeric Telegram user id of the owner. This user is always an admin.

PORT.description: HTTP port for the health check. Koyeb and Heroku set this automatically.

ADMINS.description: Optional extra admin user ids, separated by spaces or commas

FORCE_SUB_CHANNEL.description: Channel or group id (or @username) users must join. Use 0 to disable.

JOIN_REQUEST_ENABLED.description: true or false. When true, submitting a join request counts as joined. Requires FORCE_SUB_CHANNEL.

START_MESSAGE.value:
Hello {first}

I can store private files in a channel and other users can access them from a special link.

START_PIC.description: Optional public image URL sent with /start. Leave empty for text only.

FORCE_SUB_MESSAGE.description: HTML message shown when a user has not joined the force-sub channel
FORCE_SUB_MESSAGE.value: Hello {first} You need to join my channel before you can use this link.

PROTECT_CONTENT.description: true or false. true stops users from forwarding shared files.

AUTO_DELETE_TIME.description: Seconds before a delivered file is deleted. 0 disables auto-delete.

AUTO_DELETE_MSG.description: Message shown with a delivered file. Placeholder: {time}
AUTO_DELETE_MSG.value: This file will be automatically deleted in {time} seconds. Save anything you need before then.

AUTO_DEL_SUCCESS_MSG.description: Message shown after the file is deleted
AUTO_DEL_SUCCESS_MSG.value: Your file has been deleted. Thank you for using this bot.

DISABLE_CHANNEL_BUTTON.description: true or false. true does not add the Share URL button on database-channel posts.

USER_REPLY_TEXT.description: Reply sent when a non-admin sends a normal message. Empty disables it.
USER_REPLY_TEXT.value: I only share files through links. Use a file link, or send /start.

LOG_FILE.description: Log file path, or none to log only to stdout
